job.job_description:
Role Summary:
Looking for an experienced AI Engineer with 8-9 years of expertise in AI/ML, Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, MLOps, and cloud platforms. The candidate will design, develop, and deploy scalable AI solutions, AI agents, chatbots, and enterprise GenAI applications.

Key Skills:

Python, SQL, Fast API, Flask, Django
Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Generative AI
GPT, Llama, Claude, Gemini, Open-source LLMs
LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen
RAG, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, Vector Databases
PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Hugging Face
MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, Databricks
Azure, AWS, GCP
PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB

Responsibilities:

Build and deploy AI/ML and GenAI solutions.
Develop LLM-based applications, chatbots, and AI agents.
Implement RAG architectures and vector search solutions.
Build AI APIs, microservices, and end-to-end AI pipelines.
Establish MLOps, model monitoring, and governance practices.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and mentor junior engineers.

Preferred:

AI/ML or Cloud Certifications.
Experience in Healthcare, BFSI, Retail, or Technology domains.
Exposure to Multi-Agent Systems, Responsible AI, Spark, Kafka, and AI Copilot development.
